description: This file contains React custom hooks and utility functions related to fetching and processing user data from the backend API, specifically 'useUsers' hook for fetching user data with pagination, filtering, and sorting, and 'aggregateUsersByDepartment' for processing user arrays into aggregated department counts.

methods.name: useUsers({ page, limit, sort, filter } = {})
methods.description: A React hook to fetch users from the backend API, managing loading, error states, and supporting refetching. It accepts parameters for pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: aggregateUsersByDepartment(users)
methods.description: A utility function to aggregate an array of user objects into counts per department, ignoring invalid or unknown department entries.

ctags.name: useUsers
ctags.pattern: /^export function useUsers({ page, limit, sort, filter } = {}) {$/
